item.name: Strength I
item.effect: Adds a 10% catch-strength boost against pets.
item.bestUse: Roll this at Bee Island when you want the most common strength bump on a lasso you plan to keep.
item.cardSummary: Bee Island's most common roll. It is the only Strength I result and adds a 10% catch-strength boost.

item.name: Strength II
item.bestUse: Roll at either table when you want a stronger catch lasso instead of a rare utility result.
item.cardSummary: Mid-tier strength enchant. Both Enchanting Tables can roll it at 12.5%.

item.name: Strength III
item.bestUse: Keep this if it lands. It is the rarest strength roll on both tables.
item.cardSummary: Rarest strength enchant. Both tables can roll it at 7.5%.

item.name: Luck I
item.bestUse: Go to Bee Island if you specifically want Luck I, because Cave Island cannot roll it.
item.cardSummary: Bee Island only. 20% of Bee rolls, and the only way to get Luck I.

item.name: Luck II
item.bestUse: Roll at either table when you want the higher luck enchant.
item.cardSummary: Higher luck enchant. Both tables can roll it at 15%.

item.name: Mythical Hunter
item.effect: Makes mythical pets 50% easier to catch.
item.bestUse: Put this on a strong lasso when you are hunting mythical pets.
item.cardSummary: Rare 5% roll at both tables. It makes mythical pets 50% easier to catch.

item.name: Boss Catcher
item.effect: Lets you catch bosses without another player.
item.bestUse: Save this for a late-game lasso when you want to farm bosses alone.
item.cardSummary: Rare 5% roll at both tables. It lets one player catch bosses that normally need help.

item.name: Crystalise
item.effect: Gives caught pets a 20% chance to receive the Crystal mutation, a 1.9x income mutation.
item.bestUse: Use on a catching lasso when you want wild catches to have a shot at Crystal.
item.cardSummary: Cave Island exclusive 5% roll. Caught pets can gain the Crystal mutation, which is a 1.9x income mutation rather than a Trait Machine trait.

item.name: Magnify
item.bestUse: Roll at Cave Island when you want this later Cave outcome instead of Crystalise or Tiny.
item.cardSummary: Cave Island exclusive 5% roll. It is not on the Bee Island table.

item.name: Tiny
item.bestUse: Roll at Cave Island when you want this later Cave outcome instead of Crystalise or Magnify.
item.cardSummary: Cave Island exclusive 5% roll. It is not on the Bee Island table.
